title: Proposal follow-ups
description: Nudge prospects who got a proposal or quote from the owner by email and haven't answered, once after a few days and once more later

settings.WORDS: words that mark a sent email as a proposal (in its subject or text); a PDF attached counts too
settings.NUDGE_AFTER_DAYS: days after the proposal for the first and the second nudge
settings.LOOK_BACK_DAYS: how far back to look at sent proposals
settings.MESSAGES: the first and second nudge, in the owner's voice; {name} and {subject} are filled in
settings.SEND: send the nudges (true) or keep them as drafts for the owner (false)
